hook_text: Three rocks walk into a museum. One of them fizzes. Which one?
clip_script: Lichtenburg, North West. Table one: sandstone. Sand grains glued together, gritty like sandpaper. The Union Buildings are made of it. Table two: shale. Hardened mud, smooth, splits into thin sheets. Crush it and fire it: bricks and tiles. Table three: limestone. Made of ancient sea shells. Add vinegar: fizz! Heat it with clay in a giant kiln: cement. Three rocks, all with layers, all building our world.
visual_style: Whiteboard museum with three labelled rock tables, a vinegar dropper and bubbles, and arrows to a building, bricks and a cement bag.
mood: Proud museum guides with a fizzy surprise.
pacing: Three tables, one fact and one use each.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and look for sandstone and brick buildings near you.
